baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future guidance verb at word 1, causative repair verb at word 2, and possessed state noun at word 3 form a two-action promise.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gentle direction establishes orientation; repair opposes corruption; the possessed psychic field is what gets restored. The coordinated future verbs therefore move from reorientation to inward integration.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward a path supplies reorientation and functions as the first phase of the promise.
Fitness opposed to corruption supplies actual repair and functions as the restorative second phase.
The psychic and attentional field supplies the repair's object and locates the effect inwardly.

changed_reading.before: A generic promise of guidance followed by improvement.
changed_reading.after: A two-stage promise to reorient the persons and then restore the inner field from which concern, judgment, and attention arise.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Word 1 can concern direction and manner, while words 2-3 concern making the recipients' condition suitable.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance sets a course, intention, and mode of proceeding; repair then makes the whole condition compatible with that course. This is calibration rather than merely supplying information.

activation_trace.role: Direction, conduct, and intended course supply the trajectory that the first verb establishes.
Suitability and congruence supply the fitting operation performed on the recipients.
Overall condition and affairs supply the broad domain made compatible with the established course.

changed_reading.before: They are told where to go and their circumstances improve.
changed_reading.after: Their course and intention are aligned, then their whole condition is made fit for that orientation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The guidance verb at word 1 can carry composed bearing, and the repair verb at word 2 can carry reconciliation within the state named at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Calm bearing replaces destabilized motion, while reconciliation removes estrangement among competing inward impulses. The result is not mere quiet but a coherent self able to proceed without internal civil conflict.

activation_trace.role: Stillness and good bearing supply composure and function as the visible posture of restored orientation.
Removal of estrangement supplies reconciliation and functions as the relation-changing repair.
The inner self and its concerns supply the parties and field brought back into accord.

changed_reading.after: Their inwardly estranged impulses are reconciled into calm, coherent bearing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The guidance root at word 1 includes a gift-to-a-beloved branch, while words 2-3 specify the beneficial content bestowed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first action can color the entire promise as gracious conveyance: restoration is delivered to recipients as a relational gift, not only achieved through their successful execution of instructions.

activation_trace.role: A gentle gift sent toward one held in affection supplies a bestowed-benefit frame for both future actions.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the beneficial content of the bestowal.
Flourishing condition and eased affairs supply the gift's experienced result.

changed_reading.before: The recipients must follow directions in order to become better.
changed_reading.after: A restored condition is graciously conveyed to them, with guidance itself carrying a relational gift-tone.

context_deltas.mechanism: Covered wrongdoing removes a disabling residue, while intended work is explicitly protected from loss. Repair of condition thus includes restoration of moral efficacy and continuity between agent and deed, not only a better feeling.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the focus action that reverses moral damage.
The recipients' overall condition and affairs supply the domain in which moral efficacy is restored.
Erasing an offense by covering it supplies removal of the residue that precedes the repeated repair.
Moral badness supplies the defect removed before the recipients' condition is repaired.
Loss supplies the threatened fate denied of the slain persons' deeds and makes preservation part of the repair mechanism.
Intended action supplies what remains attached to the persons across the transition.

structural_cues: 47:2 repeats the focus's repair-plus-possessed-state construction immediately after wrongs are covered.
47:4 places the focus immediately after the assurance that the slain persons' works will not be lost.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covered wrongs, a repeated repair-of-state clause, and a denial that intended works are lost; I supply the arrow that preserved moral efficacy feeds restoration of the agent. A live alternative is that these are parallel rewards rather than causal stages.

changed_reading.before: Guidance and repair primarily improve the recipients' inward mood.
changed_reading.after: The promise preserves the agent-deed relation across loss, clears moral damage, and restores a condition in which the recipients' intended work remains effective.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death on an extended path is followed by a forward-leading orientation, fitting of condition, inward entry, and recognition of a sheltered destination. The focus becomes the transition operation between death and arrival.

activation_trace.role: A guide or leading element at the front supplies forward conveyance through the transition.
Making something suitable supplies the fitting of the recipients for the destination that follows.
Overall condition and affairs supply what must be made destination-ready.
Loss of embodied life supplies the threshold across which the promised guidance now operates.
An extended traversable path supplies continuity between the prior sacrifice and the focus's orientation.
Passage into an interior supplies the arrival event for which the focus prepares them.
A garden sheltered by growth supplies the destination receiving the repaired persons.
Recognition through signs supplies destination-familiarity and makes the guidance culminate in oriented arrival.

structural_cues: The focus's plural pronouns continue the group identified as killed at the end of 47:4.
The two future verbs of 47:5 stand directly between non-loss of deeds and entry into a destination made recognizable in 47:6.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies death, path, entry, sheltered destination, and recognition in immediate sequence; I supply the arrow that the focus performs the transition and destination-fitting between them. A live alternative is non-spatial moral guidance before a later, separate entry.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises general moral direction and improved circumstances.
changed_reading.after: It can promise post-death orientation and reconditioning: they are led across a threshold, made fit for arrival, and enter a destination they can recognize.

context_deltas.mechanism: People already characterized by guidance receive an increase of guidance and a gifted protective capacity. Guidance is therefore recursive growth in receptivity and stable orientation, while repair names the capacity expansion that lets further guidance take hold.

activation_trace.role: Gentle orientation supplies the focus process whose iterability is tested by the later recurrence.
Suitability supplies the receptive calibration that allows orientation to deepen.
Guidance both already possessed and newly supplied establishes a recursive rather than one-time process.
Increase and growth supply the directional change from existing orientation to enlarged capacity.
Bestowal supplies the means by which protective capacity arrives rather than being self-generated.
Protection that wards off harm supplies the stabilizer that preserves growing orientation.

structural_cues: 47:17 predicates a further guidance-gift of subjects already marked as guided.
Increase and bestowed protection are coordinated in one short sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prior guidance, added guidance, and bestowed protection; I supply the arrow that repair expands and stabilizes receptive capacity. A live alternative is that the two guidance events are distinct rewards with no capacity mechanism between them.

changed_reading.before: Guidance corrects recipients who lack direction.
changed_reading.after: Guidance recursively enlarges an orientation already present, and repair makes that growing orientation more receptive and resistant to reversal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inner field is portrayed as diseased, closed, vulnerable to decorated desire, capable of regression after guidance, and containing hostility that can be brought out. Repair thus becomes an unlocking, diagnostic, and extractive operation that restores receptivity.

activation_trace.role: Correction from corruption supplies the restorative operation applied to the damaged inner system.
The psychic field supplies the shared locus for disease, closure, seduction, and repair.
The heart supplies a concrete inward locus whose condition can be repaired.
Departure from health and balance supplies the pathology that repair reverses.
Hard closure supplies the access blockage that an effective inward repair must overcome.
Regression from a prior commitment supplies the failure mode that repaired orientation must resist.
Previously manifest orientation supplies the state from which regression occurred and which repair must stabilize.
An inwardly decorated suggestion supplies the mechanism by which desire corrupts prior orientation.
Bringing a hidden content into exposure supplies the extractive phase of repair.

structural_cues: 47:24 places closures on hearts, and 47:25 stages a backward turn after guidance had become clear.
The branchless root ض غ ن at 47:29 word 11 and 47:37 word 6 marks concealed rancor structurally; no branch identity is assigned to it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disease, closure, regression after guidance, embellished desire, and exposure of concealed rancor; I supply the arrow that focus-repair removes these blockages and maladaptive contents. A live alternative is that the defects characterize a different group and illuminate the focus only by contrast.

changed_reading.before: Repair means inward consolation or a generally improved state.
changed_reading.after: Repair can be an active inward operation: reopen receptivity, correct imbalance, expose embedded hostility, and prevent seduced regression from prior guidance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Corruption appears as severed kin relations, while peace is separately presented as a contested public act. The plural recipients' repaired condition can therefore include restoration of relational fabric, but not collapse into an indiscriminate or weak truce.

activation_trace.role: Reconciliation that removes interpersonal estrangement supplies the focus's social repair mechanism.
Shared condition and affairs supply a collective domain wider than private emotion.
Departure from sound order supplies the social damage that reconciliation opposes.
Severing a bond supplies the concrete relational failure that repair reconnects.
Kin relation supplies the social tissue damaged by severance.
Peace opposed to war supplies a public settlement model while the local prohibition limits it as premature capitulation.

structural_cues: 47:22 grammatically couples corruption in the land with cutting kinship bonds.
47:35 rejects calling for peace from weakness, so reconciliation and tactical surrender cannot simply be equated.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies severed kinship, corruption, and a qualified peace setting; I supply the arrow that the plural state repaired in the focus includes a relational network. A live alternative is that the state noun remains wholly individual and the social cues serve only as distant contrast.

changed_reading.before: Each recipient privately receives a better inner state.
changed_reading.after: Their shared affairs and damaged relations may be repaired into social coherence, without making repair synonymous with weak or premature capitulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Stabilized footing, heart-bound resolve, fulfilled commitment, testing, restraint from panic, and refusal of weakness form an operational sequence. Repair of the inner state becomes restored agency under pressure: a condition capable of sustained action.

activation_trace.role: Course, intention, and manner supply the practical orientation that must survive pressure.
The inward field of concern and resolve supplies the capacity repaired for action.
Strengthening and stabilization supply the anti-collapse action that makes orientation durable.
Courageous advance supplies the behavioral expression of repaired resolve.
Binding the heart decisively to an undertaking supplies the decision point at which inner repair becomes action.
Fulfilling a commitment in action supplies the test of whether repaired resolve is real.
Testing that reveals condition supplies the pressure under which repaired agency becomes observable.
Restraining the self from panic supplies the persistence component of usable resolve.
Loss of strength and flagging resolve supply the deficit that this action-capable repair reverses.

structural_cues: 47:7 joins divine aid to stabilized feet.
47:21 moves from acceptable speech to the moment when an undertaking becomes decisive, while 47:31 tests who strives and remains patient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies footing, decision, enacted truthfulness, revealed testing, patience, and weakness; I supply the arrow that focus-repair integrates these into operational agency. A live alternative is that the bodily and decisional images are separate exhortations rather than components of one repair process.

changed_reading.before: The repair offers consolation after hardship.
changed_reading.after: The repair restores usable agency: stable orientation, decided resolve, restraint under test, and the ability to carry intention into action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A permanence branch that explicitly concerns a condition settled in the heart turns repair from temporary relief into stabilized inward persistence. The repaired state is one that no longer rapidly relapses.

activation_trace.role: Repair opposed to corruption supplies the change that must become durable.
The inner state supplies the locus in which durable settlement occurs.
A condition fixed and settled in the heart supplies persistence as a property of the repair.

structural_cues: 47:15 places permanence inside the destination contrast, making durability rather than momentary affect salient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a permanence branch that locates settled condition inwardly; I supply the arrow that the focus's repair reaches non-relapsing stabilization. A live alternative is that the branch only colors duration in 47:15 and does not specify the mechanics of 47:5.

changed_reading.before: Their troubled state is relieved for the moment.
changed_reading.after: Their inner condition is repaired into a settled, persistent configuration rather than a transient easing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a bodily, branch-distant gait image rather than the ordinary directional sense. It remains anchored in the focus's guidance inventory and is reinforced by explicit feet, stabilization, unrecovered stumbling, and weakness cues; downstream prose should call it an embodied rehabilitation analogy, not a literal translation of guidance as medical treatment.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 guidance root includes walking with support under weakness, while words 2-3 allow the recipients' condition to be made suitable again.

activation_trace.role: An assisted, swaying walk under weakness supplies the embodied guide-image and makes orientation a supported gait.
Making a condition suitable supplies rehabilitation from unstable motion to usable movement.
Strengthening supplies the stabilizing intervention that corrects the assisted gait.
The literal foot supplies the bodily locus that turns orientation into gait.
A stumble with no recovery supplies the negative locomotor image that supported guidance reverses.
Weak force and flagging resolve supply the deficit from which the recipients are rehabilitated.

changed_reading.before: Guidance points out a route to independently capable travelers.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be imagined as supporting recipients whose gait and resolve cannot yet bear them, while repair restores stable movement.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapped root for word 1 and lets destructive context pressure a normally benevolent verb. It remains formally anchored by that supplied split inventory and functionally anchored by the following repair verb; downstream prose must label it a form-distant break-then-rebuild activation, never a claim that the ordinary verb lexically means demolition.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The supplied split mapping for word 1 includes severe breakage, directly followed by the focus's explicit repair action at word 2.

activation_trace.role: Severe breaking and demolition supply a form-distant first phase that dismantles an unfit configuration.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the rebuilding phase and keeps the destructive activation subordinate to restoration.
Overall condition supplies the configuration dismantled and reconstituted.
Overpowering through burden and weakening supplies immediate contextual pressure toward structural collapse.
Root-level annihilation supplies the wider destructive pole against which restorative reconstruction becomes legible.

changed_reading.before: Guidance preserves and redirects an otherwise continuous self.
changed_reading.after: A form-distant reading allows an unfit configuration to be broken down first and then reconstituted into a sound condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus noun's fluid branch and maps moral-psychic repair onto material flow. It remains anchored in the supplied focus inventory and in the context's opposed images of open pure flow versus scalding internal rupture; downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy and must not lexicalize the focus noun as bodily waste.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-3 root includes a trickling-fluid branch, while word 2 explicitly supplies restoration rather than damage.

activation_trace.role: Released and trickling fluid supplies the material substrate for a clearance-and-flow analogy.
Repair opposed to corruption constrains the fluid image toward restored flow rather than mere discharge.
Opening and widening until flow becomes possible supplies unobstructed channels as the positive material model.
Water at both beneficent and destructive poles supplies the material whose quality determines whether an interior is sustained or harmed.
Freedom from admixture supplies purification as the condition of beneficial flow.
Internal cramping and rupture supply the negative bodily outcome that repaired flow reverses.
The bowel supplies the vulnerable interior through which destructive fluid makes the material contrast concrete.

changed_reading.before: The recipients' abstract condition is improved.
changed_reading.after: Their condition can be pictured materially as obstructed or contaminated flow being reopened and clarified instead of rupturing the interior.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a protected-person or prisoner branch from the focus is activated by captivity procedures in the preceding verse even though the nearest grammatical antecedent is the slain group. It remains anchored in the focus inventory and the immediate binding-release-ransom-entry sequence; downstream prose should call it a legal-social safe-conduct analogy and openly note the antecedent mismatch.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-1 inventory includes safe conduct for a protected person or prisoner, and the focus then repairs the transferred group's condition.

activation_trace.role: Protected status for a vulnerable person or prisoner supplies safe conduct as an alternative guidance image.
Removal of estrangement supplies the status change from hostile custody toward protected transfer.
Binding used to secure a captive supplies the initial constrained status.
Release without compensation supplies one transition out of custody.
Ransoming a prisoner supplies the alternative legal mechanism for release and transfer.
Entry into an interior supplies the protected transfer's endpoint.

changed_reading.before: Guidance is instruction delivered to free agents.
changed_reading.after: Guidance can be analogized to safe conduct: vulnerable recipients are released from a constrained status, transferred under protection, and admitted inward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the focus noun's offspring branch and shifts repair from the named persons to communal continuity. It remains anchored in the word-3 inventory and gains a visible mechanism from severed kinship plus replacement by another group; downstream prose should label it a lineage-and-succession analogy, not translate the noun as descendants or erase the focus's individual referents.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-3 root includes an offspring branch, while the plural repair verb can carry a collective continuity effect.

activation_trace.role: Offspring and generational continuation supply the branch-distant object whose continuity can be repaired.
Reconciliation of separated parties supplies repair of communal continuity rather than only private affect.
Kin relation supplies the continuity threatened by severance.
One entity standing in another's place supplies succession as the repair mechanism after loss.
A human collective supplies the successor body through which continuity is maintained.

changed_reading.before: Repair concerns only the surviving inner state of each named recipient.
changed_reading.after: Repair can be analogized to preserving communal and generational continuity, with a successor collective standing where loss would otherwise sever the line.

strongest_changes: The immediate death-path-entry-recognition sequence changed generic guidance into postmortem orientation and destination-fitting.
Covered wrongs and protected works changed repair from mood improvement into restored moral efficacy and continuity between agent and deed.
Disease, closure, regression, seduction, and exposure changed inner repair into an unlocking and extractive operation.
Already-guided recipients receiving increased guidance changed the process from initial correction into recursive capacity growth.
Stabilized feet, decided resolve, testing, patience, and weakness made repair include usable agency under pressure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact three-root inventory supported directional, affective, relational, material, and legal mechanisms at once. The supplied split mapping and branch-distant fluid, assisted-gait, safe-conduct, and offspring images generated live but explicitly contained outliers; the missing rancor inventory was used only as a structural cue, with no invented branch ID.
remaining_uncertainties: The timing of guidance may be postmortem transition, prior moral formation, or both without a single forced choice.
The state noun may foreground psyche, whole condition, collective affairs, or an embodied analogy at different points.
The destructive split-root and fluid, legal, and lineage activations may be productive sound-and-branch echoes rather than lexical readings.
Several heart and social cues describe contrasting groups, so their transfer into the focus mechanism remains abductive rather than referentially direct.
